{{Otheruses|Capacitor}}
'''Optic capacitors''' were components used in [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn's]] [[C-14A stun grenade/Legends|C-14A stun grenade]]. When activated, the optic capacitors released an energy burst, which was funnelled into [[Beam splitter/Legends|beam splitters]]. The resulting energe discharge blanketed an area with disorientating [[Stun/Legends|stun]] energy.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
